release_notes:
- An open project is locked: it can't be moved, renamed or overwritten while open (it can still be copied)
- Double-clicking a project that is already open brings its window to the front; an empty window opens the next project you double-click
- Drag and drop a .prj onto the window to open it
- Project Status brought up to date: test pits are no longer flagged for SPT, field files show 'In progress', new warnings for missing GPS, color and core recovery; Details lists the depths
- Fixed: a new window could offer, and delete, another open window's autosave; cancelling Save As from the unsaved-changes prompt no longer discards the work
